description:
You are an IT administrator performing a routine system health audit of the Emoncms energy monitoring platform. Navigate to the Emoncms admin panel (http://localhost/admin) and other relevant pages to gather system information. Create a plain-text report file at '/home/ga/system_health_report.txt' with the following format (one key-value pair per line):

EMONCMS_VERSION: <version>
MYSQL_VERSION: <version>
PHP_VERSION: <version>
REDIS_STATUS: <Connected or Disconnected>
MQTT_STATUS: <Disabled, Connected, or Disconnected>
FEED_COUNT: <integer>
INPUT_COUNT: <integer>

The Emoncms instance is running at http://localhost/ and you are logged in as admin. Ensure the file contains accurate values reflecting the current system state.
